title: Forbidden Combined Attack
next_chapter_hook: Just as the Yuan Ying puppet's corpse collapsed with a thunderous crash, the Tianji Record at Chen Ji's brow suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light—the fourth page, that fragment he had never seen before, was slowly revealing its text upon it, yet it was a name he absolutely should not have seen.

text.content: The instant the sword light tore through the night sky, the formation array deep within the ruins shattered as well. Fragmented spirit patterns scattered like fireflies, yet suddenly converged mid-air, transforming into a towering blood-colored pillar of light—a signal that the guardian puppet had been awakened. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, the Tianji Record trembled violently within his Mental Sea, projecting an image that made his scalp crawl: a colossal puppet beast, its entire body wreathed in Yuan Ying stage spiritual pressure, was slowly rising from the fissures in the earth, its copper-bell-like eyes locked onto the two of them.

Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, as if commenting on the pleasant weather. He didn't turn to look at Ye Qing, yet he had already sensed her same shock from the fluctuation in her aura. Yuan Ying Early Stage, an entire major realm of suppression—throughout the entire cultivation world, those who could slain above their level from Foundation Building were merely a handful. And he, Chen Ji, never thought he would be among those few—at least, not in single combat, absolutely not.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path fog needs three breaths to condense, Chen Ji, buy me time!

text.content: A rare anxiety flickered in Ye Qing's golden pupils. She formed seals with both hands, demonic energy churning around her like a tide, yet appearing unstable from her previous consumption. Chen Ji didn't respond verbally, but his figure already shot forth like lightning—he positioned himself between the puppet beast and Ye Qing, his sword slanted toward the ground in the most basic defensive stance. Foundation Building against Yuan Ying, an ant trying to stop an elephant, how laughable? The puppet beast clearly thought the same. It stomped forward, each step making the earth tremble, as if a single footfall could crush this overreaching ant to dust.

The Tianji Record Fragment flipped rapidly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, his consciousness sinking into that chaotic prophetic space. Three breaths, he needed to find a sliver of survival within three breaths. The images flowed rapidly, each frame a countdown to death—First breath, the puppet beast's spiritual pressure shattered his legs; Second breath, its claws pierced his chest; Third breath, Ye Qing unable to hold on alone, both of them buried here together.

A curve appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth—a curve that might seem like a death spasm in the eyes of the puppet beast, yet made Ye Qing's heart tighten from afar. She recognized this expression—every time Chen Ji wore such a smile, the prey had already fallen into the web he had woven.

choice.prompt: The puppet beast's spiritual pressure bore down like a collapsing mountain, Chen Ji needed to buy Ye Qing the final two breaths of time. He chose:

choices.description: Deliberately expose a flaw to lure the puppet beast's attack, buying time at the cost of self-injury. The price is that he will participate in the combined attack wounded, reducing the success rate.
choices.visible_cost: Qi and blood depleted by thirty percent
choices.visible_reward: Buy Ye Qing the full three breaths of condensation time
choices.risk_hint: Performing the Forbidden Combined Attack while wounded carries the risk of meridian reversal

text.content: The puppet beast's claws tore through his left shoulder, blood spattering as Chen Ji let out a grunt, yet his figure remained standing like a dying candle in the wind, refusing to fall. He forcibly endured that strike with his flesh and blood, causing the puppet beast's assault to pause for half a breath—it seemingly hadn't expected this ant to possess such resilience.

choices.memory_label: 陈机为我挡下了致命一击

choices.description: Use the weakness of the puppet beast glimpsed through the Tianji Record to interfere verbally, disrupting its attack rhythm. The risk is that the opponent might not be affected by psychological warfare and strike directly to kill.
choices.visible_reward: Buy time for Ye Qing's condensation while preserving full combat strength
choices.risk_hint: If verbal interference fails, will face the Yuan Ying puppet's full-power strike

text.content: Chen Ji didn't retreat but advanced instead, actually confronting that enormous creature, and sneered: "A thousand-year-old puppet, possessing only brute strength. The spiritual pattern in your core—hasn't it already cracked into three pieces?" The puppet beast's advance actually stalled for an instant, a flash of suspicion flickering in those copper-bell-like eyes. It hadn't expected a Foundation Building ant to be able to see through its thousand-year-old spiritual pattern layout at a glance.

dialogue.content: (Shocked internally) How does he know... Could he possibly deduce even such things?

text.content: The Demonic Path Fog spread like ink staining a pond, shrouding a hundred zhang in all directions within chaos. The puppet beast's perception was completely disrupted, it let out an enraged roar, spiritual pressure surging in all directions like a tide, yet could never lock onto the position of those two ants. Just then, Ye Qing's voice rang out from within the fog, cold yet resolute:

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, I have a forbidden secret technique that can merge my spiritual power with a man's, sharing life and death together—but I need you to trust me completely.

text.content: Forbidden Combined Attack. Chen Ji had seen this name in Demonic Path classics—it was a forbidden technique created in ancient times by a Demonic Path Saintess and a Daoist genius, requiring two people to entrust their lives to each other, with spiritual powers completely resonating. Once either person harbored stray thoughts, the other would die with shattered meridians. He looked at Ye Qing within the fog—those golden pupils held not a trace of retreat, only an almost obsessive determination.

choice.prompt: The Forbidden Combined Attack requires absolute trust and entrustment. Chen Ji chooses:

choices.description: Without hesitation, grasp Ye Qing's hand, pouring all spiritual power into the combined attack formation without reservation. This is true sharing of life and death.
choices.visible_cost: Spiritual power emptied, weakness for three days afterward
choices.visible_reward: Forbidden Combined Attack perfectly executed, slaying the Yuan Ying puppet above level
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing's spiritual power becomes unstable midway, will suffer severe backlash injury

text.content: Chen Ji's hand grasped Ye Qing's. That hand was cold and soft, yet at the moment of contact, a scorching spiritual fluctuation burst forth. Two completely different forces intertwined, collided, and finally merged into one at the point of contact—Dao and Demonic converge, Yin and Yang complement each other, as if重现天地初开时的 the chaos of the world's beginning.

choices.memory_label: 他的手握住了我的手，毫无保留

choices.description: While spiritual powers merge, secretly retain a thread of divine consciousness to prepare for unexpected events. Reduces the combined attack's power but preserves a retreat route.
choices.visible_cost: Combined attack power weakened by thirty percent, Yuan Ying puppet may not be killed in one strike
choices.visible_reward: Preserve adaptability, if it fails can still escape
choices.risk_hint: Incomplete combined attack may intensify the backlash

text.content: At the instant of spiritual power merging, Chen Ji secretly left a thread of divine consciousness as a retreat route. The two forces barely merged, yet clearly were not pure enough—Ye Qing noticed that slight gap, a complex emotion flickering in her golden pupils, but she didn't expose it.

dialogue.content: (Heart chilled) At the final moment, he still didn't fully trust me...

text.content: Forbidden Combined Attack—Execute!

A dazzling golden-white intertwined light suddenly bloomed within the Demonic Path Fog, a unprecedented grand fusion of Daoist pure energy and Demonic Path murderous aura. Chen Ji felt as if he were immersed in a realm of chaos, Ye Qing's aura intertwining and crossing with his, the two of them no longer independent individuals but transformed into a peerless divine sword. The sword's point aimed directly at the core spiritual pattern of that Yuan Ying puppet.

The puppet beast sensed the fatal threat, abandoning its search within the fog, condensing all spiritual pressure into its two claws, roaring as it struck toward that golden-white light—this was the full-power strike of a Yuan Ying stage expert, sufficient to level half a mountain. Yet Chen Ji had already foreseen this moment, the Tianji Record projecting every crack in the puppet beast's spiritual patterns within his Mental Sea, the combined attack's angle impossibly precise.

The golden-white divine sword pierced through the puppet beast's chest, accurately striking the cracked core spiritual pattern. The Yuan Ying puppet's movements froze mid-action, its massive body suspended in mid-air, those copper-bell-like eyes filled with不甘 and disbelief. A堂堂 Yuan Ying Early Stage expert, killed by two Foundation Building juniors? Its consciousness, in the final moment before dissipation, seemed to glimpse its own crushed fate—from that moment, the countdown reached zero.
Boom—!

The Yuan Ying puppet's corpse collapsed thunderously, stirring up clouds of dust. When the dust settled, Chen Ji and Ye Qing stood facing each other, their hands still tightly clasped, their spiritual powers slowly separating. That feeling of sharing life and death was so intense that upon parting, each other's palms retained the illusion of the other's warmth.

Ye Qing's voice was very soft, nearly scattered by the night wind. But Chen Ji understood—within those three breaths of spiritual power merging, she had touched some of the deepest things in his heart. Those deepest calculations he hid, the coldest scheming, and... some softness he himself was reluctant to admit.

choice.prompt: After the Forbidden Combined Attack, both felt some things from each other's deepest hearts. Chen Ji chooses:

choices.text: Pretend to be relaxed to resolve the awkwardness
choices.description: Use his usual sharp tongue to steer the conversation away, not allowing this vulnerable moment to last too long. Maintain his usual disguise.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity for deeper communication
choices.visible_reward: Maintain thetrash persona, Ye Qing's doubts in his heart deepen
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may become even more persistent in excavating his true face

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Saintess's spiritual power is indeed powerful enough. Next time we cooperate, remember to discuss the split in advance.

text.content: Chen Ji released his hand, as if nothing had happened, even brushing dust off his sleeves. Ye Qing watched him quietly, a flash of emotion passing through her golden pupils that even she herself could barely recognize—was it disappointment, or a more intense curiosity?

choices.memory_label: 他总是这样，用轻佻掩饰一切

choices.description: Since being seen through, stop concealing. The first time showing his true self before Ye Qing—even if just for an instant.
choices.visible_cost: True self exposed, difficulty of future schemes increases
choices.visible_reward: The relationship with Ye Qing undergoes qualitative change, unlocking "Shared Fate" prologue
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may therefore be drawn deeper into his fate

text.content: Chen Ji didn't release the hand, nor did he look away. He simply watched Ye Qing quietly, the layer of habitual coldness and calculation in his eyes receding like a tide, revealing something complex and profound beneath—was it the unique loneliness of a chess player, or the exhaustion a scheme-maker was reluctant to show.

dialogue.content: Did you see it? This is me.

choices.memory_label: 他第一次对我展露真实

text.content: Just then, the Tianji Record at Chen Ji's brow suddenly shuddered violently. He lowered his head to look at his own hands—that dilapidated ancient scroll was turning on its own, golden light flowing, the outline of the fourth page slowly manifesting. He had never seen this page before—the Tianji Record's incompleteness was only three pages, and he had always believed that was everything. Yet now, the fourth page was emerging with an almost fervent intensity, as if something had been slain, released, awakened.

The golden light grew more intense, Ye Qing instinctively stepping back, yet she was enveloped within that radiance. Her pupils reflected the content of the Tianji Record's fourth page—text she couldn't understand, yet made her entire body grow cold. Because though she didn't recognize those characters, she莫名地 felt familiar, as if long, long ago, in some deliberately forgotten memory's depths, she had seen them before.

Chen Ji didn't answer. His gaze locked死死 on the text on the fourth page—there was only one sentence written there—not ancient text, not the common language of the cultivation world, but his previous life's mother tongue, the hidden heavenly way of this world: "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key has appeared, countdown to shackles opening begins."
Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Chen Nian.

Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly. He schemed across the world, his calculations never missing, yet he had never expected his sister's existence to have such a direct connection to the Tianji Record's completeness. The truth of the shackles begins to reveal its edge—and behind that edge lies a terrifying truth sufficient to overturn all his cognition. His sister, exactly what kind of person is she? Or rather, exactly what kind of thing is she?

Just then, in the Demonic Path camp millions of miles away, that figure which had been sleeping for years finally completely awakened. The celestial phenomena aberration in those golden pupils had dissipated, replaced by an almost manic excitement. "Finally... found it..." That voice was hoarse and ancient, yet contained pressure sufficient to tear apart the heavens, "The complete key to the Tianji Record, is right there..."
